content: The Dental Clinic demo offers dental cleaning, dental exam, teeth whitening, fillings, and emergency dental visits.
Dental cleaning starts at $120. Dental exams start at $90. Teeth whitening starts at $250. Fillings start at $180. Emergency dental visits start at $150 before treatment costs.
Dental Clinic demo hours are Monday through Friday from 8 AM to 5 PM, with Saturday appointments from 9 AM to 1 PM.
Dental appointments should be cancelled or rescheduled at least 24 hours in advance. Late arrivals may need to be rescheduled.
For a dental cleaning, patients should allow about 45 to 60 minutes. For whitening, patients should allow about 75 minutes.
